text: こないだ　みたのと　おなじ　おおきさ　じゃないか？

structure.jp: こないだ　みたのと
structure.en: as the one I saw the other day

structure.jp: おなじ　おおきさ　じゃないか？

patterns.name: 〜の (the one)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb can stand in for a thing already being talked about, like 'the one'. こないだ　みたの = 'the one I saw the other day'.

patterns.name: 〜とおなじ
patterns.explanation: と before おなじ shows what something is the same as. みたのと　おなじ = 'the same as the one I saw'.

patterns.name: 〜じゃないか
patterns.span: おおきさ　じゃないか
patterns.explanation: じゃないか asks 'isn't it?' when you think the answer is yes. おなじ　おおきさ　じゃないか = 'isn't it the same size?'
